title: Hunts FH-016V: Walk a Trail end to end on a real database and record the second-device check

source.ref: Split from FH-016T (2026-11-16): the visited-stops map, on-page scan entry and run-version binding shipped with tests; the live acceptance run needs a person, two phones and a database.

detail: Owed by Web with Local operations, not by an agent: on a staging database with the Hunts switches on, publish a Trail with at least three stops, bind a placement and a venue Space to each stop, and play it from /hunts/[slug]/play on one phone using both the scanner and the typed code. Record in docs/hunts/PLAYER-ACCEPTANCE.md, with the date and the release SHA: every stop confirmed in order and the Trail finished; a second signed-in device showing the same progress and revision after each stop; the page source and network responses at each step holding no clue, place, hint or map point for a stop not yet visited; the map showing visited stops only. Done when: the note exists with those four results marked pass or fail. Requires: FH-016T, FH-020V. Owner role: Web.
